learning_objective: 🎯 Explore the amazing geometry of lines around us, from train tracks that never meet to crossroads that crash into perfect angles!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Parallel lines are like the two metal tracks of a railway line. They always keep the exact same distance from each other and will never touch, no matter how far they travel!
When two lines cross each other at a single point, they are called intersecting lines. Think of a big letter X or a crossroads in your city. Where they meet, they form angles!
A transversal is a special line that cuts across two or more other lines. When it slashes through parallel lines, it creates magical matching angles that geometry experts love to study.

fun_activity.title: 🧩 The Geometry Hunt
fun_activity.instructions: Take a walk around your house or look out the window. Find and write down 3 real-world examples of parallel lines and 3 examples of intersecting lines!

quick_recap: ⭐ Parallel lines stay the same distance apart forever and never cross.
⭐ Intersecting lines meet exactly at one point called the vertex.
⭐ Angles are formed whenever two straight lines intersect each other.
